profile.name: Dot Allison
profile.short_bio: Scottish singer-songwriter and electronic vocalist best known as the frontwoman of early-1990s trio One Dove. She began a solo career in the late 1990s, blending trip-hop, downtempo and dream-pop on albums like Afterglow and We Are Science, and worked closely with producer Andrew Weatherall.

profile.name: Sammy Dee
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer closely associated with Berlin’s Perlon label, known for stripped‑down minimal/microhouse. He is one half of Pantytec with Zip and of Half Hawaii with Bruno Pronsato, and runs the Ultrastretch imprint.

profile.name: X-Press 2
profile.short_bio: X-Press 2 is a London-based UK house outfit, originally the trio of Ashley Beedle, Darren Rock (Rocky) and Darren House (Diesel), later continuing as Rocky & Diesel. They broke through on Junior Boy's Own with "Muzik Xpress" and "Smoke Machine" and scored a major hit with "Lazy" featuring David Byrne, with key releases on Junior Boy's Own and Skint Records.

profile.name: Pär Grindvik
profile.short_bio: Swedish techno producer and DJ, founder of the Stockholm LTD label. Known for powerful, melodic-leaning techno; his debut album Isle Of Real was released on Stockholm LTD.

profile.name: Nathan Fake
notable_releases: Drowning in a Sea of Love
profile.short_bio: English electronic producer from Norfolk who broke through on James Holden’s Border Community with early singles like Outhouse and the cult classic The Sky Was Pink (famously remixed by Holden). He has released acclaimed albums including Drowning in a Sea of Love, Hard Islands and Steam Days, later co-founding the Cambria Instruments label and issuing music via Ninja Tune.

profile.name: Anderson Noise
profile.short_bio: Brazilian DJ and producer from Belo Horizonte, Anderson Noise is a pioneer of Brazil’s techno scene. Active since the 1990s, he is known for driving techno and minimal/tech house sounds and for founding the Noise Music label.

profile.name: Junior Boys
profile.short_bio: Junior Boys are a Canadian electronic pop duo from Hamilton, Ontario, formed by Jeremy Greenspan and Matthew Didemus (originally with Johnny Dark). They blend sleek synth-pop with microhouse and techno influences and have released acclaimed albums on Domino and City Slang. Key works include Last Exit, So This Is Goodbye, and Big Black Coat.

profile.name: Tobias Freund
profile.short_bio: German electronic producer and engineer based in Berlin, active since the 1990s. Known for precise, analog-leaning minimal/techno releases as Tobias. on Ostgut Ton and collaborations such as NSI. with Max Loderbauer and projects with AtomTM. Also part of the duo Sieg Über Die Sonne with Dandy Jack.

profile.name: Tiga
profile.short_bio: Montreal-based Canadian DJ and producer Tiga is the founder of Turbo Recordings and a key figure in electroclash and electro house. He broke through with 2001’s 'Sunglasses at Night' (with Zyntherius) and went on to release club staples like 'You Gonna Want Me,' 'Pleasure From the Bass,' 'Bugatti,' and 'Let's Go Dancing' with Audion.

profile.name: Pascal F.E.O.S.
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer from the Frankfurt scene, Pascal F.E.O.S. (Pascal Dardoufas) was active from the early 1990s and became known for work on Eye Q and Harthouse as well as his own Planet Vision. He recorded as Sonic Infusion and was part of Resistance D and the ambient project Aural Float. He passed away in 2020.

profile.name: Plastikman
profile.short_bio: Plastikman is the minimal/acid techno alias of Canadian producer Richie Hawtin. Emerging from the Windsor/Detroit scene in the early 1990s via Plus 8 and Novamute, he became known for stark rhythms and 303-driven sound design across albums like Sheet One, Musik, Consumed and Closer; classic singles include Spastik.

profile.name: Marc Antona
profile.short_bio: Marc Antona is a French minimal/tech house producer and DJ associated with the Dissonant label. His productions are known for deep, rolling grooves and refined percussive detail.

profile.name: Markus Fix

profile.name: Telefon Tel Aviv
profile.short_bio: Telefon Tel Aviv is an American electronic act formed in New Orleans by Joshua Eustis and Charles Cooper. They debuted with Fahrenheit Fair Enough on Hefty in 2001 and became known for a blend of IDM, glitch and ambient across albums including Map of What Is Effortless and Immolate Yourself. Following Cooper’s death in 2009, Eustis revived the project for Dreams Are Not Enough on Ghostly International in 2019.

profile.name: Daniel Dubb

profile.name: Beck
profile.short_bio: Beck is an American singer, songwriter and producer from Los Angeles known for blending alternative rock, folk, hip hop and electronic elements. He broke through with the 1993 single Loser and earned wide acclaim with albums like Odelay and Sea Change; Morning Phase won the 2015 Grammy for Album of the Year.

profile.name: FFWD

profile.name: Shinedoe
profile.short_bio: Amsterdam-based Dutch DJ and producer known for sleek, groove-led techno and tech house. She co-founded Intacto Records with 2000 and One and has released on 100% Pure and her own imprint Music That Moves.

profile.name: Catz 'n Dogz
profile.short_bio: Polish house/tech house duo of Grzegorz Demianczuk and Wojciech Tarańczuk, formerly known as 3 Channels. They run the Pets Recordings label and its STEP imprint, with notable releases on Dirtybird/Mothership. Albums include Stars of Zoo, Basic Colour Theory and Friendship.

profile.name: Elektrochemie
profile.short_bio: Elektrochemie is a German trio of Stephan Bodzin, Thomas Schumacher, and vocalist Caitlin Devlin active in the mid-2000s. They released vocal-driven minimal/tech house on Get Physical Music, including the club hits Mucky Star and Pleasure Seeker.

profile.name: Deadbeat
notable_releases: The Infinity Dub Sessions (with Paul St. Hilaire)
profile.short_bio: Deadbeat is the alias of Canadian producer Scott Monteith, a Berlin-based artist known for richly textured dub techno. He emerged in the early 2000s on ~scape and Wagon Repair and later founded his BLKRTZ label. Collaborations with Paul St. Hilaire and albums like Drawn and Quartered and Walls and Dimensions cemented his standing in modern dub techno.

profile.name: Slam
profile.short_bio: Slam are a Scottish techno duo from Glasgow, comprising Stuart McMillan and Orde Meikle. They co-founded Soma Records and are known for influential releases including Positive Education and the albums Headstates and Alien Radio.

profile.name: Samim
profile.short_bio: Swiss producer Samim Winiger is a minimal/tech house artist best known for his 2007 crossover hit "Heater" on Get Physical Music. He has also released material with Michal Ho as the duo Samim & Michal.

profile.name: Will Saul
notable_releases: Will Saul & Tam Cooper - Sequential Circus
profile.short_bio: British DJ, producer and label head best known for founding Aus Music and Simple Records. He works across deep and tech house and has collaborated frequently with Tam Cooper and Mike Monday. Saul has released a DJ-Kicks mix and, under his Close alias, the album Getting Closer on !K7.

profile.name: Andomat 3000

profile.name: The Vegetable Orchestra

profile.name: Jennifer Cardini

Key works include the albums Animals and Blomma and singles like The Leopard and Jamaica.

profile.name: Phil Kieran
profile.short_bio: Phil Kieran is a Belfast-based DJ and producer from Northern Ireland known for driving, melodic-tinged techno and tech house. He has released on labels such as Cocoon and Turbo, records under his Le Carousel project, and was a member of the band Alloy Mental.

Core artists of Circus Company and also linked to Get Physical Music, their catalog includes tracks like Kitchen and albums such as Songs on the Rocks and Dring.

profile.name: Rainer Weichhold
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer known for tech house and minimal-leaning club tracks. He co-founded Kling Klong with Martin Eyerer and has been associated with Great Stuff Recordings. His single Bamboo became a notable club hit.

profile.name: Wighnomy Brothers
notable_releases: Slam - This World (Wighnomy Bros. & Robag Wruhme Remix)
profile.short_bio: Wighnomy Brothers are the Jena, Germany duo of Gabor Schablitzki (Robag Wruhme) and Sören Bodner (Monkey Maffia), central to the Freude Am Tanzen/Musik Krause collective. They became known in the 2000s for quirky, groove-led minimal and tech-house productions and distinctive remixes, including their acclaimed take on Slam's This World.

profile.name: 2000 And One
profile.short_bio: 2000 And One is the Amsterdam-based DJ/producer Dylan Hermelijn, a key figure in Dutch house and techno since the 1990s. He founded 100% Pure and co-founded Intacto Records (with Shinedoe), as well as the Remote Area family of labels, helping shape the modern tech house sound. Known for peak-time cuts like Spanish Fly and Tropical Melons.

profile.name: André Galluzzi
profile.short_bio: André Galluzzi is a German DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house, and as a longtime Berghain/Panorama Bar resident. He has released and mixed on labels such as Ostgut Ton and Cocoon, and has collaborated with artists including Guido Schneider and Paul Brtschitsch (as Taksi). He also co-runs the ARAS label.

profile.name: Sun Electric
profile.short_bio: Sun Electric is a Berlin-based electronic duo of Max Loderbauer and Tom Thiel. Active since the early 1990s, they are known for lush ambient techno and IDM releases on Apollo/R&S, including the albums Kitchen, Present and the live set 30.7.94 Live.

profile.name: Akiko Kiyama
profile.short_bio: Akiko Kiyama is a Japanese electronic music producer and live performer known for minimal techno and microhouse. Active since the 2000s, she has released music via her own imprint Kebko Music.

profile.short_bio: German techno DJ/producer from the Frankfurt scene, active since the early 2000s. Founder of the Break New Soil label, he broke through with the track A Thousand Nights and has released on imprints such as Cocoon and Great Stuff. He frequently collaborates with Petar Dundov.

profile.name: Reboot
profile.short_bio: Reboot is the German DJ and producer Frank Heinrich from Frankfurt, known for percussive minimal techno and tech house. He rose to prominence in the late 2000s with releases on labels like Cadenza and Cécille. His track Caminando became a key cut of the era.

profile.name: Booka Shade
profile.short_bio: Booka Shade is the German house/tech-house duo of Walter Merziger and Arno Kammermeier, originally from Frankfurt am Main. They co-founded the label Get Physical Music and broke through in the mid-2000s with tracks like Body Language, Mandarine Girl and In White Rooms and the album Movements.

profile.name: Chloé
profile.short_bio: Chloé Thévenin is a Paris-based DJ, producer and composer known for atmospheric minimal techno and house. A key figure in the Kill The DJ milieu, she later founded Lumière Noire Records and released albums including The Waiting Room and Endless Revisions.

profile.name: From Karaoke To Stardom
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: The Deepshakerz
profile.short_bio: The Deepshakerz are an Italian house/tech-house duo of Domy Berardino and Mirco Sonatore from Bari. They run the Safe Music label and have released on imprints such as Defected/DFTD, Toolroom and Cajual.

profile.name: Black Strobe
profile.short_bio: Black Strobe is a Parisian electronic act formed in 1997 by Arnaud Rebotini and Ivan Smagghe, known for a dark, EBM-influenced electroclash sound. Early singles on Output Recordings led to cult hits like Me and Madonna, and their blues-charged cover I'm A Man broadened their reach; later the project continued under Rebotini.

profile.name: John Selway
profile.short_bio: New York-based American DJ and producer known for driving techno and tech house, both solo and as half of Smith & Selway with Christian Smith. He has released on labels such as Drumcode and Tronic and runs the CSM imprint. Active since the 1990s.

profile.name: Guido Schneider
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer known for refined minimal/tech house, closely associated with Poker Flat Recordings. Active in the Berlin scene, he has collaborated with Jens Bond and worked as part of Glowing Glisses with vocalist Florian Schirmacher.

profile.name: Jochen Trappe
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Marco Effe
profile.short_bio: DJ and producer known for tech house and minimal-leaning techno.

profile.name: Ladida
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Argy
profile.short_bio: Greek DJ and producer active since the mid-2000s, Argy broke through with Love Dose on Poker Flat and later released on Afterlife. His sound spans stripped tech-house roots through to modern melodic techno, with widely played tracks like Tataki and Pantheon (with Goom Gum).

profile.name: Butch
profile.short_bio: German DJ/producer Bülent Gürler, known as Butch, is a Mainz-based figure in tech house and minimal techno. He co-founded the bouq. label and has released on Cécille, Desolat, Great Stuff and Trapez, with club hits like No Worries and Amelie.

profile.name: Tyrone Palmer
profile.short_bio: Tyrone Palmer is a vocalist known in the techno/house scene for collaborations with Scottish duo Slam on Soma Records, including the singles Lifetimes and This World.

profile.name: Hermanez
profile.short_bio: DJ and producer known for tech house and minimal techno.

profile.name: Pär Grindvik
profile.short_bio: Swedish techno producer and DJ, founder of the Stockholm LTD label. Known for driving, emotive techno and releases like Monuments and the 2016 album Isle Of Real.

profile.name: Marc Houle
profile.short_bio: Canadian minimal techno producer and live performer from the Windsor/Detroit scene. Long-time Minus artist and co-founder of Items & Things with Magda and Troy Pierce, he is known for analog, melodic minimal and tracks like Techno Vocals and albums such as Restore and Drift.

profile.name: Anthony Collins
profile.short_bio: French-born DJ and producer in the minimal/deep house scene, active since the late 2000s. He later co-founded the Scissor & Thread label with Francis Harris as the duo Frank & Tony.

profile.name: Âme
profile.short_bio: Âme is a German duo of Kristian Beyer and Frank Wiedemann, best known for deep, melodic house/techno and for co-founding the Berlin-based label Innervisions with Dixon. They broke through with the 2005 anthem Rej and have remained influential as DJs, producers and curators.

profile.name: Justin Martin
profile.short_bio: American DJ/producer from San Francisco and a core member of the Dirtybird crew. Debuted with The Sad Piano on Ben Watt's Buzzin' Fly in 2003 and became known for bass-heavy, melody-rich tech house. Albums include Ghettos & Gardens (2012) and Hello Clouds (2016), both on Dirtybird.

profile.name: Alex
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Señor Coconut And His Orchestra
profile.short_bio: Señor Coconut And His Orchestra is the Latin big-band project of German producer Uwe Schmidt (aka Atom™), based in Santiago, Chile. The act is known for mambo/cha-cha renditions of electronic and pop classics, including tributes to Kraftwerk and Yellow Magic Orchestra. Key releases include El Baile Alemán (1997), Fiesta Songs (2003), and Yellow Fever! (2006), which features the cover Behind The Mask.

profile.name: Navid Tahernia
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Misc.
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Daniel Stefanik
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer from Leipzig known for sleek, groove-led tech house and minimal techno. He has released key records on Moon Harbour, Cocoon and Freude am Tanzen, including tracks like Say It Loud and Confidence.

profile.name: Peter Grummich
profile.short_bio: German electronic music producer and DJ associated with the early-2000s minimal techno and tech house scenes. Known for releases on Kompakt and Shitkatapult.

profile.name: Jeff Samuel
profile.short_bio: American minimal techno and tech house producer/DJ active since the 2000s and associated with the mid-2000s minimal scene.

profile.name: Daso
profile.short_bio: German producer Daso Franke, known simply as Daso, made melodic minimal/tech house for labels like My Best Friend and Connaisseur. He frequently collaborated with Pawas; his track “Thujon” is among his best-known cuts.

profile.name: Paco Osuna
profile.short_bio: Spanish DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. Founder of Mindshake Records.

profile.name: Depeche Mode
profile.short_bio: Depeche Mode are an English electronic band from Basildon, formed in 1980, whose core members have included Dave Gahan, Martin Gore and the late Andy Fletcher (with Vince Clarke an early member). They helped define synth-pop and darker electronic music, achieving global success with albums like Violator and hit singles such as Enjoy the Silence and Personal Jesus.

profile.name: Andre Kraml
profile.short_bio: German minimal/tech house producer best known for the mid-2000s track Safari featuring Shad Privat, which gained wide recognition through James Holden’s remix. Released music on Cologne’s Platzhirsch Schallplatten.

profile.name: Joris Voorn
profile.short_bio: Dutch DJ and producer based in Amsterdam, co-founder of the Green and Rejected labels with Edwin Oosterwal. Emerged in the early 2000s with releases on Sino and his own imprints, and gained wide acclaim with his Balance 014 mix and tracks like Ringo and Incident. His sound spans techno, tech house and melodic variants.

profile.name: Nhar
profile.short_bio: Electronic music producer and DJ known for melodic, minimal-leaning techno and tech house.

profile.name: MiniCoolBoyz
profile.short_bio: Italian duo known for minimal techno and tech house, associated with Dubfire’s SCI+TEC Digital Audio and with running their own imprint Amazing Records.

profile.name: Claude VonStroke
profile.short_bio: Claude VonStroke is the alias of American DJ and producer Barclay Crenshaw, founder of San Francisco’s Dirtybird label. Rising in the mid-2000s with quirky, bass-heavy tech house, he’s known for tracks like “Deep Throat” and “Who’s Afraid of Detroit?” and albums including “Beware of the Bird” and “Urban Animal.” He also collaborates with Green Velvet as the duo Get Real.

profile.name: Citizen Kain
profile.short_bio: Citizen Kain is a French techno/tech house producer and DJ. He has released on Stil vor Talent, runs the Neverending label, and frequently collaborates with fellow French artist Kiko.

profile.name: Rework
profile.short_bio: German minimal house act associated with Playhouse, best known for the track Love Love Love Yeah.

profile.name: Workidz
profile.short_bio: House project best known for the club track 'Washmachine'.

profile.name: Agnès
profile.short_bio: Swiss producer and DJ known for deep and minimal house. Also records under the alias Ray Valioso and has released on Sthlmaudio Recordings.

profile.name: Delhia
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Nick Curly
profile.short_bio: Nick Curly is a German DJ and producer from Mannheim, central to the city’s tech house and deep house scene. He co-founded 8bit Records and Cécille Records and rose to prominence with sleek, groove-led productions. Notable works include Underground, Zanzibar, Pujante, and the album Between The Lines.

profile.name: Chris Liebing
profile.short_bio: German techno DJ, producer and label owner, best known as the founder of CLR and co-creator of the Stigmata project with André Walter. He is a key figure of hard, driving techno and has collaborated extensively with Speedy J (Collabs 3000), while later releasing albums such as Burn Slow and Another Day on Mute.

profile.name: Guy Gerber
profile.short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv, founder of the Supplement Facts and Rumors labels, known for a melodic, emotive strain of house and techno. He has released on Cocoon, Bedrock and Visionquest and collaborated with Puff Daddy.

profile.name: Luciano
profile.short_bio: Chilean–Swiss DJ and producer, founder of Cadenza Records and a key figure in minimal house and tech house since the early 2000s. Known for Latin-inflected, groove-driven productions and collaborations with peers such as Quenum.

profile.name: Steve Bug
profile.short_bio: German DJ/producer and label owner, founder of Poker Flat Recordings (as well as Dessous and Audiomatique). Berlin-based and active since the mid-1990s, he is known for stripped-back house and tech-house, including the classic 'Loverboy'.

profile.name: Matthias Tanzmann
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer from Leipzig, founder of Moon Harbour Recordings. A key figure in tech house and long-time Circoloco resident at DC-10 Ibiza. Member of Better Lost Than Stupid and formerly part of the duo Gamat 3000.

profile.name: Mark Henning
profile.short_bio: UK-born DJ and producer based in Berlin, known for minimal techno and tech house. He has released on labels such as Soma Records, Clink and Safari Electronique, including the album Jupiter Jive.

profile.name: Cassy
notable_releases: Swayzak feat. Cassy - Smile and Receive (2007)
profile.short_bio: Cassy (Catherine Britton) is an Austrian DJ, producer and vocalist closely associated with Berlin’s Panorama Bar and labels like Perlon and Ostgut Ton. She has released the mix CDs Panorama Bar 01 and fabric 71, launched her own imprint Kwench Records, and issued her debut album Donna on Aus Music. She has also appeared as a vocalist with Swayzak.

profile.name: M.A.N.D.Y.
profile.short_bio: M.A.N.D.Y. is a German DJ/producer duo of Patrick Bodmer and Philipp Jung. They co-founded the Berlin-based label Get Physical Music alongside Booka Shade and DJ T., and are known for influential tech-house releases such as Body Language with Booka Shade.

profile.name: Billy Dalessandro
profile.short_bio: Chicago-based electronic music producer and DJ known for minimal techno, tech house and acid-leaning releases within the US Midwest underground.

profile.name: Chaim
profile.short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv known for deep, melodic house and tech house, with releases on BPitch Control and Supplement Facts. He is closely tied to the Tel Aviv scene and has collaborated with Jenia Tarsol.

profile.name: Matt John
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based German DJ and producer associated with the city’s minimal/microhouse and tech-house scene, with releases on Perlon, Sleep Is Commercial and Cocoon. Closely linked to the Bar25 milieu, he released the album The Keys on Cocoon.

profile.name: Benjamin Fehr
profile.short_bio: German minimal techno producer and DJ, founder of Catenaccio Records.

profile.name: Tiefschwarz
profile.short_bio: Tiefschwarz are German brothers Ali and Basti Schwarz from Stuttgart, a duo known for deep and tech house since the late 1990s. They founded the Souvenir Music label and have released on Classic, Four Music and Fine, with acclaimed albums RAL 9005 and Eat Books.

profile.name: Hobo
profile.short_bio: Hobo is Canadian producer Joel Boychuk, known for minimal techno and tech house releases on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. His track “Failsafe” is among his best-known productions.

profile.name: Pfirter
profile.short_bio: Argentine techno DJ/producer Juan Pablo Pfirter is the founder of the MindTrip label and podcast, known for hypnotic, driving techno. He has released on MindTrip, CLR, Stroboscopic Artefacts, Figure and Stockholm LTD.

profile.name: Shackleton
notable_releases: Music For The Quiet Hour / The Drawbar Organ EPs
profile.short_bio: Shackleton is English producer Sam Shackleton, co-founder of the Skull Disco label with Appleblim. Emerging from the mid‑2000s UK dubstep scene, he developed a hypnotic, percussive and experimental sound, later releasing on Perlon and his own Woe To The Septic Heart!. Noted works include Blood on My Hands, Death Is Not Final, Three EPs, and Music For The Quiet Hour / The Drawbar Organ EPs.

profile.name: Roy Horten
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: False
profile.short_bio: False is the minimal techno alias of American producer Matthew Dear. He has released primarily on Richie Hawtin's Minus and Plus 8 labels, including the album 2007.

profile.name: Damian Schwartz
profile.short_bio: Madrid-based Spanish producer and DJ associated with the Net28 collective. Known for minimal/tech-house releases on labels such as Apnea and Net28.

profile.name: Jens Bond
profile.short_bio: Jens Bond is a Berlin-based German DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. He has released on Highgrade Records and Sender Records and is associated with the track Consequence.

profile.name: Luca Bacchetti
profile.short_bio: Italian DJ and producer known for sleek tech house and minimal releases on labels such as Ovum and Wagon Repair. He later established the Endless imprint, expanding into a more melodic and cinematic sound.

profile.name: Gel Abril
profile.short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv known for driving tech-house and techno. Emerged in the late 2000s with key releases on Shlomi Aber’s Be As One Imprint and Josh Wink’s Ovum Recordings.

profile.name: Ellen Allien
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based DJ, producer and BPitch Control founder, Ellen Allien (Ellen Fraatz) is a pivotal figure in German techno since the mid-1990s. Her acclaimed albums include Stadtkind, Berlinette and Alientronic, alongside the collaboration with Apparat, Orchestra of Bubbles. Known for a distinctive blend of techno, minimal and electro.

profile.name: Nihad Tule
profile.short_bio: Stockholm-based techno producer and DJ known for streamlined, hypnotic techno and releases on Stockholm LTD.

profile.name: Maxime Dangles
profile.short_bio: French techno producer and DJ associated with Kompakt, known for the track "My Head." Member of the trio Möd3rn with Electric Rescue and Traumer. He also records under the alias DNGLS and has released on Kompakt and Skryptöm.

profile.name: Paul Ritch
profile.short_bio: French techno DJ and producer from Paris, active since the mid-2000s. He founded the label Quartz Rec and released on imprints like Drumcode and SCI+TEC, with breakout tracks such as Winter Ceremony and Split the Line.

profile.name: Soylent Green
profile.short_bio: Soylent Green is an alias of German producer Roman Flügel, associated with the Frankfurt house scene. Under this moniker he released deep, classic house on labels like Playhouse/Klang, including the standout track La Forza Del Destino.

profile.name: Gary Beck
profile.short_bio: Scottish techno DJ and producer from Glasgow, Gary Beck is known for high-impact club tracks and releases on Soma Records, Drumcode, and his own BEK Audio. His work includes the album Bring A Friend and the widely played single Say What.

profile.name: Audio Injection
profile.short_bio: Audio Injection is the techno alias of Los Angeles producer/DJ David Flores, also known as Truncate. A key member of the Droid Behavior family, he released minimal-leaning US techno on Droid Recordings and has collaborated with Drumcell as Cell Injection.

profile.name: Recloose
notable_releases: So This Is The Dining Room (EP)
profile.short_bio: Detroit-born producer Matthew Chicoine, aka Recloose, emerged in the late 1990s after Carl Craig picked up his demo and released his early work on Planet E. Known for jazzy, soulful Detroit house, he later relocated to New Zealand and collaborated with members of Fat Freddy's Drop and Dwele. Key releases include So This Is The Dining Room, Cardiology, Hiatus on the Horizon, and the tracks Can't Take It and Landed.

profile.name: Click Click
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Rino Cerrone
profile.short_bio: Italian techno DJ/producer from Naples, best known as the founder of the Rilis label and its Unrilis offshoot. His numbered Rilis series became influential DJ tools of driving, tribal techno in the late 1990s and 2000s. He has also been involved with the Naples-based Loose Records.

profile.name: Click Box
profile.short_bio: Brazilian minimal techno duo known for releases on Richie Hawtin’s Minus and later Items & Things, bringing a crisp, percussive take on minimal and tech house.

profile.name: Michele Menini
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Terri B!
notable_releases: You Used To Hold Me (with D.O.N.S.)
profile.short_bio: Terri B! is the stage name of American singer Terri Bjerre, a prominent vocalist in house music. She has appeared on numerous club records and collaborations, including work with D.O.N.S. and Cazzette.

profile.name: Omar Salgado
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Adam Beyer
notable_releases: Space Date (with Green Velvet & Layton Giordani)
profile.short_bio: Swedish techno DJ and producer from Stockholm, Adam Beyer is the founder of Drumcode Records and a key figure in the Swedish techno movement since the mid-1990s. He has released extensively on Drumcode and sister label Truesoul, with standout tracks like Teach Me and Your Mind (with Bart Skils). Frequent collaborators include Ida Engberg, Joseph Capriati, and Green Velvet.

profile.name: Microfunk

profile.name: Freaks
notable_releases: Where Were You When The Lights Went Out?
profile.short_bio: Freaks is the UK house duo of Justin Harris and Luke Solomon. Closely tied to their own Music For Freaks imprint and Classic Music Company, they’re known for quirky, off‑kilter house and the underground hit The Creeps (You're Freaky).

profile.name: Kenichiro Kubota
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Tam Cooper
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Ritmo Dynamic
profile.short_bio: Ritmo Dynamic is a house project best known for the single Calinda, a widely played club track in the early 2000s that appeared in numerous remixes and compilations.

profile.name: Colder
profile.short_bio: Colder is the project of Paris-based French artist Marc Nguyen Tan. Emerging on Trevor Jackson’s Output Recordings in the early 2000s, he fused icy post‑punk, coldwave and electro on the albums Again (2003) and Heat (2005). He later returned with new material, including Many Colours (2016) on his Bataille imprint.

profile.name: Reset Robot
profile.short_bio: Reset Robot is the alias of UK producer and DJ Dave Robertson from Portsmouth. Known for sleek, groove-led techno and tech house, he has released on Truesoul and Dubfire’s SCI+TEC and frequently collaborates with Alan Fitzpatrick.

profile.name: Apparat
profile.short_bio: Apparat is the alias of German producer Sascha Ring, a Berlin-based artist known for atmospheric electronica spanning ambient, IDM and techno. He is one third of Moderat alongside Modeselektor and has released key works on Shitkatapult, BPitch Control and Mute. Notable releases include Walls, The Devil's Walk and the singles Arcadia and Goodbye.

profile.name: Swayzak
profile.short_bio: Swayzak is a London-based UK electronic duo of James S. Taylor and David Brown, active since the late 1990s and known for minimal techno and tech house. They released acclaimed albums including Snowboarding in Argentina, Dirty Dancing and Loops From The Bergerie, and run the 240 Volts label.

profile.name: Darko Esser
profile.short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer from Nijmegen, founder of Wolfskuil Records, also known as Tripeo. Active in techno and tech house; he has also run the Balans imprint.

profile.name: Rune
profile.short_bio: Danish producer and DJ Rune Reilly Kölsch, known early as Rune/Rune RK and later as Kölsch, is behind the club classic 'Calabria' and releases melodic techno on Kompakt as Kölsch. Based in Copenhagen, he also records as part of the project Enur.

profile.name: Delete
profile.short_bio: Venezuelan producer Sergio Muñoz released minimal and tech house under the moniker Delete, and later co-founded the duo Fur Coat with Israel Sunshine.

profile.name: Konrad Black
profile.short_bio: Canadian DJ and producer associated with the Vancouver minimal techno scene and the Wagon Repair label. Known for deep, moody minimal techno and tech house with longstanding ties to Mathew Jonson.

profile.name: Kiki
profile.short_bio: Finnish-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer on BPitch Control known for sleek, electro-tinged minimal techno and tech house. He has released the albums Run With Me and Kaiku on the label.

profile.name: Fraktion
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Alex Flatner
profile.short_bio: German DJ/producer and label owner best known for running Circle Music and for frequent collaborations with Lopazz. His work is rooted in a tech house/deep house sound.

profile.name: Simon Baker
profile.short_bio: UK DJ and producer from Leeds known for deep and tech house, with key releases on 20:20 Vision and Leftroom. His track Plastik and the album Traces are among his best-known works.

profile.name: JPLS
profile.short_bio: Minimal techno producer associated with Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. Known for the album Twilite and a run of stripped, percussive EPs including the Green series and Program.

profile.name: Len Faki
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer, founder of the Figure label and a long-time Berghain resident. He has released key EPs on Ostgut Ton including 'Mekong Delta' and 'My Black Sheep', and compiled the Berghain 03 mix.

profile.name: Laurie Anderson
profile.short_bio: Laurie Anderson is an American avant‑garde composer, musician and performance artist based in New York City. She gained international recognition with the 1981 single O Superman and the album Big Science. Her work blends electronic sound design and spoken word, and she has collaborated with figures such as Brian Eno, Kronos Quartet, and her late husband Lou Reed.

profile.name: Playgroup
profile.short_bio: Playgroup is the dance project of London producer Trevor Jackson, founder of Output Recordings. Emerging in the early 2000s, the project fused electro, house and disco, yielding a self-titled album and a DJ-Kicks mix for !K7 alongside club tracks like Number One and Front 2 Back.

profile.name: James Venturi
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Marek Bois
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Janus Orghe
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Magda
profile.short_bio: Polish-born, Detroit-raised DJ and producer closely associated with Richie Hawtin’s M_nus label, known for stripped-back minimal techno and tech house. She broke through with releases like Baby Kate and the mix CD She’s A Dancing Machine, and later co-founded the Items & Things label with Marc Houle and Troy Pierce.

profile.name: Agaric
profile.short_bio: Agaric is the alias of Swedish producer and DJ Patrik Skoog, known for minimal techno and tech house. He founded the We Are label and has released on Ovum Recordings. Active since the 2000s.

profile.name: Bryan Zentz
profile.short_bio: American techno DJ/producer active since the 1990s, also known for work under his Barada alias. He has released on labels such as Intec and Definitive.

profile.name: Robert Perdini
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Mark Broom
profile.short_bio: British techno DJ and producer, founder of the Beard Man label. Known for tough, groove-driven techno on imprints like Rekids and Blueprint, and for collaborations including Rue East (with Dave Hill) and The Fear Ratio (with James Ruskin).

profile.name: Igor Krsmanovic
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Falko Brocksieper
profile.short_bio: German DJ/producer and label owner best known as co-founder of the Sub Static label (and its offshoot Karloff). Active since the early 2000s, he is associated with minimal techno and tech house.

profile.name: Carl Cox
notable_releases: All Roads Lead to the Dancefloor
profile.short_bio: British DJ and producer, a pioneer of acid house and techno, famed for high-energy three-deck sets and a long-running Space Ibiza residency. He runs the Intec Digital label and co-founded Awesome Soundwave, continuing to champion techno and live electronic performance.

profile.name: Joseph Capriati
profile.short_bio: Italian techno DJ and producer from Caserta, active since the late 2000s. He rose to prominence via Drumcode and later launched his own label Redimension, with albums including Self Portrait and Metamorfosi.

profile.name: Christian Martin
profile.short_bio: San Francisco DJ/producer and longtime member of the Dirtybird crew, Christian Martin is known for bass-heavy, groove-led tech house. He is one half of The Martin Brothers with his brother Justin Martin and has released on Dirtybird as well as his Trippy Ass Technologies imprint.

profile.name: Mustafa Avdic
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Federico Grazzini
profile.short_bio: Italian DJ and producer known for house and tech house.

profile.name: Isolée
profile.short_bio: German producer Rajko Müller, better known as Isolée, is a pioneering figure in microhouse, first rising to prominence on the Frankfurt label Playhouse with the classic single Beau Mot Plage and the album Rest, followed by the acclaimed We Are Monster. He later released on Pampa Records, continuing to refine a melodic, minimalist house sound.

profile.name: DJ Minx
profile.short_bio: Detroit DJ and producer Jennifer Witcher, known as DJ Minx, founded the Women On Wax collective and the Women On Wax Recordings label. A key figure in Detroit house and techno, she has released music on her own imprint and on M_nus, including the track A Walk In The Park.

profile.name: Roger
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Christian Smith
profile.short_bio: Swedish techno DJ and producer, founder of the Tronic label. Known for peak-time techno and collaborations with John Selway, with releases on Tronic, Drumcode and Bedrock.

profile.name: Tigerskin
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based producer Alexander Krüger records as Tigerskin (and also as Dub Taylor). Active since the late 1990s, he is known for deep and tech house releases on labels like Dessous, Dirt Crew and Moodmusic.

profile.name: Larrson
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Metazoo
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Pilas
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Microdinamic
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Josh Wink
notable_releases: How's Your Evening So Far? (with Green Velvet)
profile.short_bio: Philadelphia DJ/producer and co-founder of Ovum Recordings with King Britt. A pioneer of 1990s acid house/techno, he broke through with 'Higher State of Consciousness' and 'Don't Laugh' (as Winx) and has remained an influential club producer and remixer.

profile.name: Martinez
profile.short_bio: Swedish-born, Copenhagen-based producer and DJ Martin Swanstein, aka Martinez, is known for sleek minimal and tech-house. He has released on Cadenza, Dessous and his own Out Of Orbit imprint since the early 2000s.

profile.name: Einzelkind
profile.short_bio: Einzelkind is Frankfurt-based German DJ and producer Arno Völker. He is known for sleek minimal- and tech-house and co-runs the La Peña label, with releases also appearing on Cécille. Frequent collaborations include work with Christian Burkhardt.

profile.name: Eddie Amador
profile.short_bio: Eddie Amador is an American house DJ and producer best known for the classic track "House Music," released on Yoshitoshi Recordings. His spoken-word vocal on the record became one of house music’s most iconic lines.

profile.name: Gaiser
profile.short_bio: American minimal techno producer and live act closely associated with Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. Known for sleek, percussive sound design and a series of Minus releases, including the albums Blank Fade, False Light and On The Way.

profile.name: Ilario Alicante
profile.short_bio: Italian DJ and producer from Livorno, active since the late 2000s. He broke through with the 2008 track "Living Near Africa" on Cécille Records and became closely associated with Cocoon Recordings, known for driving techno and tech house.

profile.name: Sweet N Candy
profile.short_bio: German minimal techno/tech house producer active since the early-to-mid 2000s. Known for releases on labels such as Dumb Unit and Einmaleins Musik.

profile.name: Rhadoo
profile.short_bio: Romanian DJ and producer from Bucharest, a leading figure in the Romanian minimal scene. Member of RPR Soundsystem alongside Raresh and Petre Inspirescu and a core artist of the a:rpia:r imprint.

profile.name: Perc
notable_releases: Look What Your Love Has Done To Me
profile.short_bio: Perc is the London-based techno artist and Perc Trax label founder Ali Wells. Known for a raw, industrial edge within techno, he has released acclaimed works including the albums Wicker & Steel, The Power And The Glory and Bitter Music, and collaborates with Truss as Perc & Truss.

profile.name: Mike Wall
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer, best known as the founder of the Wall Music label. He is associated with driving, minimal-leaning techno from the Berlin scene.

profile.name: Luka & Lazo
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Jesper Dahlbäck
profile.short_bio: Swedish producer and DJ from Stockholm, Jesper Dahlbäck is a key figure in the Swedish techno/house scene. Known for his aliases The Persuader and Lenk, he has collaborated with Adam Beyer and Alexi Delano and was part of the duo DK7 with Mark O'Sullivan. His work has appeared on influential labels such as Svek, Drumcode and Output Recordings.

profile.name: Mike Dunn
notable_releases: God Made Me Phunky (as MD X-Spress)
profile.short_bio: Mike Dunn is a Chicago house DJ/producer active since the late 1980s and a key figure in the city’s jackin’ house sound. He has recorded under aliases including MD III and MD X‑Spress, behind classics like Dance You Mutha, Face The Nation and God Made Me Phunky. In recent years he has released on Classic Music Company, including the album My House From All Angles.

profile.name: Imek

profile.name: Naneci
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Robert Dietz
profile.short_bio: German DJ/producer from Frankfurt who rose in the late-2000s house/tech-house scene, releasing on labels like Cécille, Cadenza and Desolat. Known for rolling, percussive grooves with a minimal house touch.

profile.name: Gaiser
profile.short_bio: American minimal techno producer and live act best known as Gaiser, a key artist on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. He released albums including Blank Fade (2008) and False Light (2014).

profile.name: MEAT
profile.short_bio: DJ/producer best known as one half of the duo Chris Wood & MEAT, active in the tech house/house scene. Also releases solo material under the name MEAT.

profile.name: André Galluzzi
profile.short_bio: André Galluzzi is a German techno DJ and producer based in Berlin and a long-time resident at Berghain/Panorama Bar. He has released on Ostgut Ton and Cocoon Recordings and founded the ARAS label. His sound spans minimal techno and tech house.

profile.name: Shinedoe
profile.short_bio: Amsterdam-based Dutch DJ and producer known for sleek, groove-driven techno and tech house. She co-founded Intacto Records with 2000 and One and has also released under the alias Innersphere, including the notable track Phunk.

profile.name: Dejonka
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Michele Tabucchi
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: SLAJH

profile.name: Chaton
profile.short_bio: Swiss minimal techno/tech-house producer and DJ from Geneva, closely associated with the Geneva imprint Plak Records and known for collaborations with Hopen as Chaton & Hopen.

profile.name: Marcel Dettmann
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer from Berlin, long-time Berghain resident and key artist for Ostgut Ton. He runs the MDR (Marcel Dettmann Records) imprint and is known for austere, minimal-leaning Berlin techno. Notable works include his albums Dettmann, Dettmann II and Fear of Programming, and collaborations with Ben Klock such as Dawning and Phantom Studies.

profile.name: Kleinschmager Audio
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Radio Slave
profile.short_bio: Radio Slave is the primary moniker of British DJ/producer Matt Edwards, co-founder of the Rekids label. Renowned for hypnotic, loop-driven techno and tech house, he has released influential tracks like Grindhouse and Don't Stop No Sleep and mixed Fabric 48. He also records as Rekid and forms the duo Quiet Village with Joel Martin.

profile.name: Alex Under
profile.short_bio: Spanish producer and DJ from Madrid known for sleek, percussive minimal techno and tech-house. He has been closely associated with the Spanish imprints CMYKmusik and Apnea, with releases also on Trapez. Active since the 2000s within Spain’s minimal/tech-house scene.

profile.name: Lucio Aquilina
profile.short_bio: Italian producer and DJ from Naples known for playful, melodic minimal techno and tech house. He broke through with the Cocoon single Magic M and has also released on Trapez Ltd.

profile.name: Adultnapper
notable_releases: A Little Late For That Now
profile.short_bio: Adultnapper is the long-running alias of New York producer and DJ Francis Harris, known for moody minimal and tech house on Poker Flat and its sublabel Audiomatique in the 2000s. He collaborated with Mr. C as Sycophant Slags and later formed the Frank & Tony project with Anthony Collins.

profile.name: James Holden
notable_releases: The Sky Was Pink (James Holden Remix)
profile.short_bio: James Holden is a British electronic musician, DJ and producer, and the founder of the Border Community label. Emerging at the turn of the 2000s with progressive house and trance, he is widely known for his remix of Nathan Fake’s The Sky Was Pink and his albums The Idiots Are Winning and The Inheritors. He later formed James Holden & The Animal Spirits to explore live, improvisational electronics.

profile.name: Quenum
profile.short_bio: Philippe Quenum is a Swiss DJ and producer from Geneva, best known as co‑founder of Cadenza Records with Luciano. Their track "Orange Mistake" launched the label and became a landmark minimal techno release. Quenum is recognized for sleek, groove-led minimal techno and tech house, and frequent collaborations including work with Lee Van Dowski.

profile.name: Señor Coconut
profile.short_bio: Señor Coconut is the Latin-electronic project of German producer Uwe Schmidt, launched after his move to Santiago de Chile. The project is best known for tropical big-band reinterpretations of classics, notably the Kraftwerk tribute album El Baile Alemán (2000), followed by Fiesta Songs and Yellow Fever!. Releases have appeared on Essay Recordings and Schmidt’s Rather Interesting imprint.

profile.name: Tolga Fidan
profile.short_bio: Turkish-born producer and DJ known for minimal techno and tech house, with key releases on Vakant. Active within the European minimal scene.

profile.name: Daniel Steinberg
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based house and tech house DJ/producer. He also records tougher techno as Harry Axt and co-runs the Arms & Legs label with Nils Ohrmann, with earlier releases on Front Room Recordings. Active since the mid-2000s.

profile.name: Mute
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Barem
profile.short_bio: Argentinian DJ and producer from Buenos Aires, known for stripped-back minimal techno and tech house. Rose to prominence as part of Richie Hawtin’s Minus roster in the mid-to-late 2000s. Co-founder of Fun Records alongside Alexis Cabrera.

profile.name: Martin Eyerer
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer known for tech house and techno. He co-founded the Kling Klong label.

profile.name: Monika Kruse
profile.short_bio: German techno DJ and producer based in Berlin, Monika Kruse is the founder of Terminal M Records and a longstanding figure in European club culture. Active since the 1990s, she has released and collaborated widely, including the project Monika Kruse @ Voodooamt, and issued the album Traces on her label.

profile.name: Phunklarique
profile.short_bio: Phunklarique is an electronic music producer known for minimal techno and tech house, with notable collaborations alongside Dejonka during the 2000s.

profile.name: Shlomi Aber
profile.short_bio: Israeli techno and tech house DJ/producer best known for releases on Ovum and for founding the Be As One Imprint. Key tracks include Diosa and Freakside.

profile.name: Raudive
profile.short_bio: Raudive is the house/techno alias of London producer Oliver Ho. He is known for stripped, experimental-leaning minimal and tech-house releases, including work on Stefan Goldmann’s Macro label.

profile.name: Steadycam
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Andy Lee
profile.short_bio: Deep house DJ/producer who also releases under the alias Central Avenue.

profile.name: Super Flu
profile.short_bio: Super Flu is a German tech house duo from Halle (Saale), known for playful, melodic club productions. They are closely associated with the Monaberry label, with standout tracks like Jo Gurt.

profile.name: Gui Boratto
profile.short_bio: Gui Boratto is a Brazilian producer and composer from São Paulo, best known as a key artist on Kompakt. He broke through with his album Chromophobia (2007), delivering melodic, emotive techno and tech house hits like Beautiful Life and No Turning Back. He also runs the D.O.C. imprint and frequently collaborates with vocalist Luciana Villanova.

profile.name: Italoboyz
profile.short_bio: Italian duo Italoboyz (Marco Donato and Federico Marton) emerged from the minimal/tech house scene and based themselves in London. They became known for quirky, sample-led releases on Mothership and Moon Harbour, most notably the underground hit Viktor Casanova.

profile.name: Uto Karem
profile.short_bio: Italian techno DJ and producer, founder of Agile Recordings.

profile.name: Mikael Stavöstrand
profile.short_bio: Swedish producer known for minimal techno and microhouse, active since the late 1990s. He has released on labels such as Mitek, Contexterrior and Adjunct Audio, and later based himself in Los Angeles. His work focuses on reduced grooves and experimental textures.

profile.name: Innersphere
profile.short_bio: Innersphere is an alias of Amsterdam-based DJ/producer Shinedoe, best known for the mid-2000s minimal/tech house anthem 'Phunk'.

profile.name: Davide Squillace
profile.short_bio: Italian DJ and producer from Naples, central to the Neapolitan techno movement. Known for sleek tech house and minimal productions, he runs the labels This And That Lab and Minisketch and has released on Cadenza and Desolat. He is also part of the trio Better Lost Than Stupid with Matthias Tanzmann and Martin Buttrich.

profile.name: Heartthrob
profile.short_bio: Heartthrob is the alias of American producer Jesse Siminski, a key figure from Richie Hawtin’s Minus roster who later launched his own imprint ISNISNT. Emerging in the mid‑2000s, he is known for sleek minimal techno and tech-house, including the breakout single Baby Kate and the album Dear Painter, Paint Me.

profile.name: Winx
profile.short_bio: Winx is an alias of Philadelphia DJ/producer Josh Wink (Joshua Winkelman). Under the Winx name he released influential 1990s acid house/techno tracks including "Don't Laugh" and "Are You There?". He also co-founded the Ovum Recordings label.

profile.name: Marco Carola
profile.short_bio: Marco Carola is an Italian DJ and producer from Naples, a key figure in the Neapolitan techno movement. He founded labels such as Design Music, Question and Zenit, later releasing the album Play It Loud! on M_nus and launching the Music On brand in Ibiza. Known for driving, minimalist grooves, he bridges techno and tech house in long-form DJ sets.

profile.name: Sleeparchive
profile.short_bio: Sleeparchive is the minimal techno project of Berlin-based producer Roger Semsroth. Emerging in the mid‑2000s, he is known for stark, loop-driven tracks and releases on his own Sleeparchive imprint as well as Tresor.

profile.name: Dan Curtin
profile.short_bio: American producer and DJ from Cleveland, active since the early 1990s. He founded the Metamorphic Recordings label and released influential work on Peacefrog Records. His music spans techno, house and electro.

profile.name: Dustin Zahn
profile.short_bio: American techno DJ and producer from Minneapolis. Founder of Enemy Records and known for the club anthem "Stranger (To Stability)". Has released on labels including Rekids and Drumcode.

profile.name: Niederflur
profile.short_bio: Niederflur is a minimal techno project known for releases on Richie Hawtin's Minus label.

profile.name: TC
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Marlon D
profile.short_bio: House DJ and producer known for the anthem 'Jesus Creates Sound'.

profile.name: Matthew Dear
notable_releases: Tiga vs Audion - Let's Go Dancing
profile.short_bio: Matthew Dear is an American electronic producer, DJ, and vocalist from the Detroit/Ann Arbor scene, and a co-founder of Ghostly International and its dance imprint Spectral Sound. Under his own name and as Audion he helped define 2000s minimal techno and microhouse, later expanding into leftfield pop on his albums. Key works include Leave Luck to Heaven, Asa Breed, Black City, and Audion’s club classic Mouth to Mouth.

profile.name: Heinrichs & Hirtenfellner
profile.short_bio: Heinrichs & Hirtenfellner are a Berlin-based German duo associated with Highgrade Records, known for minimal techno and tech house releases.

profile.name: D'Julz
profile.short_bio: Parisian DJ and producer Julien Veniel, better known as D'Julz, is a key figure of the French house scene. He founded the long-running Bass Culture night at Paris's Rex Club and the Bass Culture Records label, with releases on imprints such as Ovum. His sound focuses on deep, groovy house and tech house.

profile.name: Miss Kittin
profile.short_bio: French DJ, producer and vocalist Caroline Hervé, aka Miss Kittin, rose from the late-1990s electroclash scene with The Hacker, issuing classics like Frank Sinatra and 1982 on International Deejay Gigolo Records. She later pursued a solo career with albums such as I Com and collaborated on hits like Rippin Kittin (with Golden Boy) and Silver Screen Shower Scene (with Felix da Housecat).

profile.name: Dachshund
profile.short_bio: Dachshund is a Swiss DJ and producer from Geneva known for minimal and tech house. He co-founded the Geneva-based label Clapper with Quenum.

profile.name: Tyrone
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Florian Meindl
profile.short_bio: Austrian techno producer, DJ and sound designer based in Berlin, and the founder of FLASH Recordings and the Riemann Kollektion. Active in the European techno scene with releases spanning techno, minimal and tech house.

profile.name: Chris Carrier
profile.short_bio: French DJ/producer from Paris known for groove-driven house and tech house. He runs the Adult Only label and has released on Robsoul and Catwash Records.

profile.name: Antonio Pocai
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Someone Else
profile.short_bio: Someone Else is the minimal techno/tech-house project of American producer Sean O'Neal from Philadelphia. He co-founded the labels Foundsound and Unfoundsound.

profile.name: Tom Budden
profile.short_bio: UK DJ/producer and label owner behind ALiVE Recordings, known for tech house releases including 'The Tree Dance'.

profile.name: Nico Forster
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Hardfloor
notable_releases: Mory Kante – Yé ké yé ké (Hardfloor Remix)
profile.short_bio: Hardfloor is a German acid techno duo from Düsseldorf, formed by producers Oliver Bondzio and Ramon Zenker. Renowned for their multi-TB-303 sound and releases on Harthouse, they broke through with Acperience 1 in 1992 and delivered iconic remixes such as New Order’s Blue Monday.

profile.name: Daniel Sanchez
profile.short_bio: Amsterdam-based Dutch DJ/producer known in the minimal/tech house scene. He founded Bla Bla Records and gained wider attention with the late-2000s track Mumbling Yeah on Remote Area/100% Pure.

profile.name: Dubfire
profile.short_bio: Dubfire is the solo project of Iranian-American DJ and producer Ali Shirazinia, formerly one half of the Grammy-winning duo Deep Dish. Since 2006 he has focused on sleek, minimal-leaning techno, founding the SCI+TEC label and releasing tracks like Roadkill and Ribcage alongside collaborations with Oliver Huntemann. He is a prominent figure in the global techno scene.

profile.name: GummiHz
profile.short_bio: Greek DJ/producer known for releases on Mobilee Records and for running the Claap label, working in minimal/tech house.

profile.name: Robag Wruhme
profile.short_bio: Robag Wruhme is the alias of German producer and DJ Gabor Schablitzki from Jena, known for a melodic, idiosyncratic strain of minimal techno and microhouse. He rose to prominence as half of Wighnomy Brothers alongside Monkey Maffia before focusing on solo work. He has released on Pampa Records, Kompakt and the Jena labels Freude-Am-Tanzen/Musik Krause, with highlights including the albums Thora Vukk and Venq Tolep and the Cybekks EP.

profile.name: Pitto
profile.short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer working in the tech house/deep house sphere, associated with Joris Voorn and Edwin Oosterwal’s Rejected label. Known for the club track "Sexvibe."

profile.name: Massimo Girardi
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: TG
profile.short_bio: TG is an alias of British producer Tim Green, used for stripped‑back minimal and tech house material.

profile.name: Marc Ashken
profile.short_bio: UK producer and DJ from London best known for releases on Leftroom and Leftroom Limited. His work sits in the minimal techno and tech house spectrum and was part of the UK minimal wave in the mid-to-late 2000s.

profile.name: Paco Osuna
profile.short_bio: Spanish techno DJ and producer from Barcelona, and the founder of Mindshake Records. He co-founded Barcelona’s Club4 party alongside Marco Carola, Adam Beyer and Christian Smith, and has been a mainstay at Ibiza institutions such as Music On and ENTER.

profile.name: Lusine
profile.short_bio: Lusine is the project of Seattle-based American producer Jeff McIlwain. Active since the late 1990s, he is known for emotive, precision-crafted electronics spanning IDM, ambient techno and microhouse, with key releases on Ghostly International and earlier work as Lusine ICL on Hymen Records. Notable albums include Serial Hodgepodge, A Certain Distance, The Waiting Room and Sensorimotor.

profile.name: Lopazz
profile.short_bio: Lopazz is the moniker of Heidelberg-based producer Stefan Eichinger, closely associated with Get Physical since the early 2000s. He broke through with the single I Need Ya on Output and went on to craft leftfield house and tech‑house, frequently collaborating with Alex Flatner and Casio Casino.

profile.name: Repeat Repeat
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Gaiser
profile.short_bio: American minimal techno producer Jon Gaiser is a key artist on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label, known for sleek, percussive live sets and streamlined studio work.

profile.name: Kabale und Liebe
profile.short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer from Amsterdam associated with the minimal/tech-house scene. Best known for the track 'Mumbling Yeah' on Remote Area.

profile.name: Ben Klock
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer, longtime Berghain resident. Known for releases on Ostgut Ton and for running the Klockworks imprint. A key figure of modern Berlin techno since the mid-2000s.

profile.name: Fatboy Slim
notable_releases: You've Come a Long Way, Baby
profile.short_bio: Fatboy Slim is the big beat alias of British DJ and producer Norman Quentin Cook from Brighton. Breaking through on Skint Records in the late 1990s, he scored global hits like The Rockafeller Skank, Praise You and Weapon of Choice. Formerly of The Housemartins, he has also led projects such as Beats International, Pizzaman and Mighty Dub Katz.

profile.name: Ambivalent
profile.short_bio: Ambivalent is the techno alias of American producer/DJ Kevin McHugh. He broke through on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label in the late 2000s with the minimal anthem “R U OK?”, later launching his Valence imprint and exploring acid-leaning work as LA-4A.

profile.name: Dirka Dirka
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Anja Schneider
profile.short_bio: German DJ, producer and label owner based in Berlin. She co-founded mobilee records in 2005 and, after leaving in 2017, launched her own imprint Sous Music. A longtime radio host, she is a key figure in Europe’s tech house and minimal scenes.

profile.name: Gabriele Del Prete
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Samklang
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Kaiserdisco
profile.short_bio: Kaiserdisco is a German duo from Hamburg comprising Frederic Berger and Patrick Buck. They are known for groove-led techno and tech house, founding the KD Music and KD RAW labels and releasing on Drumcode as well as MBF. Their early breakthrough included the track Aguja and the album In No One's Shadow.

profile.name: Doomwork
profile.short_bio: Doomwork is an electronic act focused on tech house and house.

profile.name: Donnacha Costello
profile.short_bio: Irish producer from Dublin known for warm, analog-leaning minimal techno and house. He ran the Minimise label, released early work with D1 Recordings, and issued the acclaimed album Together Is The New Alone on Mille Plateaux. He is also celebrated for the 2004 Colorseries run of 12-inches.

profile.name: Traffic Signs
profile.short_bio: Traffic Signs is a stripped-down house/tech-house alias of German producer Steve Bug (Stefan Brügesch). The project delivered a run of club-focused 12-inches on the Traffic Signs imprint in the early-to-mid 2000s, including cuts like Infiltrate and The Big Fake.

profile.name: Jorge Savoretti
profile.short_bio: Argentine DJ and producer from Rosario, Jorge Savoretti is a key figure in his country’s minimal/house scene and co-runs the Savor Music label. His groove-led productions and DJ sets span minimal house and tech house, with releases on Savor Music and Germany’s Raum...musik.

profile.name: Mihai Popoviciu
profile.short_bio: Mihai Popoviciu is a Romanian DJ and producer from Sibiu, known for sleek, groove-driven minimal and deep tech house. He has released on labels such as Highgrade Records, Poker Flat Recordings and Bondage Music, and is part of the Hermannstadt Collective with Jay Bliss; his album Home appeared on Bondage Music.

profile.name: Moritz Piske
profile.short_bio: Electronic music producer known for minimal and tech house.

profile.name: Jona
profile.short_bio: Belgian producer/DJ known for minimal and tech house releases on Get Physical Music in the mid-2000s, including the club track Manta.

profile.name: Tom Clark
profile.short_bio: Berlin-based German DJ and producer known for minimal and tech house. He is closely associated with the Berlin label Highgrade Records.

profile.name: Louderbach
profile.short_bio: Louderbach is the dark, vocal-led minimal techno project of American producer Troy Pierce.

profile.name: Tiger Stripes
profile.short_bio: Tiger Stripes is the alias of Swedish producer Mikael Nordgren from Stockholm. He emerged in the mid-2000s with a sound spanning house, tech house and techno, releasing on labels such as Get Physical and Ibadan. He has also collaborated with Jerome Sydenham.

profile.name: Koba
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Samuel L. Session
profile.short_bio: Swedish techno DJ and producer recognized for a stripped, percussive sound with Detroit influences. A long-time figure within the European techno scene.

profile.name: Camea
profile.short_bio: American-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. She founded the Clink Recordings imprint in the mid-2000s and later launched the Neverwhere label and radio show.

profile.name: Drumcell
profile.short_bio: Drumcell is the Los Angeles–based techno artist Moe Espinosa, co-founder of the Droid Behavior collective and its Droid Recordings label. He is known for heavyweight, industrial-leaning techno with releases on CLR and Droid Recordings, and for projects such as Cell Injection and Belief Defect. Espinosa also explores ambient and experimental work under his Hypoxia alias.

profile.name: Mærtini Brös
profile.short_bio: Mærtini Brös is a Berlin-based German duo of DJ Clé and Mike Vamp, known for their tech house and minimal-leaning club productions. Active as producers and performers, they became fixtures of Germany's post-1990s club scene.

profile.name: Julian Collazos
profile.short_bio: DJ and producer active in the tech house scene.

profile.name: Ludovic Vendi
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Alexi Delano
profile.short_bio: Swedish-Chilean producer and DJ active since the mid-1990s, rooted in Stockholm’s techno and house scene. Known for minimal techno, tech house and deep house releases on labels like Svek, Truesoul and Plus 8, and for collaborations with Jesper Dahlbäck and Tony Rohr.

profile.name: Dave Shokh
profile.short_bio: Minimal techno and tech house DJ/producer. Further details unknown.

profile.name: Joe Stawarz
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Bukaddor & Fishbeck
profile.short_bio: German production duo known for minimal techno and tech house releases on My Best Friend/Traum Schallplatten in the mid-2000s, including the club track Polterabend.

profile.name: Richie Hawtin
profile.short_bio: British-born Canadian DJ/producer Richie Hawtin is a pioneer of minimal techno, emerging from the Windsor–Detroit scene. He co-founded Plus 8 with John Acquaviva and later launched M_nus, while defining the genre with his Plastikman and F.U.S.E. projects. Landmark releases include Sheet One, Consumed, and the mix album Decks, EFX & 909.

profile.name: Mark Brown
profile.short_bio: UK house/tech house DJ and producer, founder of Cr2 Records, and one half of the duo MYNC/MYNC Project. Known for the crossover single The Journey Continues featuring Sarah Cracknell.

profile.name: Audion
notable_releases: Tiga vs Audion - Let's Go Dancing
profile.short_bio: Audion is the minimal/techno alias of American producer Matthew Dear. Active since the mid-2000s on Ghostly International’s Spectral Sound imprint, he’s best known for the 2006 club anthem Mouth to Mouth and the album Suckfish. He has also collaborated with Tiga, notably on Let’s Go Dancing.

profile.name: Mathew Jonson
profile.short_bio: Canadian producer and live performer known for melodic, hardware-driven minimal techno. He co-founded Wagon Repair and is a core member of Cobblestone Jazz and The Modern Deep Left Quartet. Best known for classics like Decompression and Marionette, he has long been based in Berlin.

profile.name: Xpansul
profile.short_bio: Spanish techno and minimal producer/DJ active since the 2000s.

profile.name: Tocadisco
profile.short_bio: German DJ and producer known for electro- and tech-house. He gained wide attention with his remix of The Egg's 'Walking Away', which became the basis of David Guetta's 'Love Don't Let Me Go (Walking Away)'. He has released on Toolroom Records and his own Toca45 imprint.

profile.name: Mike Shannon
profile.short_bio: Canadian minimal techno and tech house DJ/producer, best known as the founder of Cynosure Recordings.

profile.name: Sascha Funke
profile.short_bio: Berlin DJ and producer Sascha Funke is a key figure of Ellen Allien’s Bpitch Control, known for melodic minimal/tech house. He broke through with the club track Baby Kate and released albums including Bravo and Mango; later he formed the duo Saschienne and also issued work via Kompakt and Endless Flight.

profile.name: Partycrashers
profile.short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

profile.name: Sebastian Ingrosso
notable_releases: Reload (with Tommy Trash feat. John Martin)
Calling (Lose My Mind) (with Alesso feat. Ryan Tedder)
profile.short_bio: Sebastian Ingrosso is a Swedish DJ and producer from Stockholm, co-founder of Swedish House Mafia with Axwell and Steve Angello. He runs Refune Records and is known for progressive house anthems like Reload and Calling (Lose My Mind). Active since the early 2000s.

profile.name: Pheek
profile.short_bio: Montreal-based producer and label owner Jean-Patrice Rémillard, aka Pheek, is a longstanding figure in minimal techno and microhouse. He founded the Archipel label and has released a substantial catalog of experimental, groove-led music.

profile.name: Pan-Pot
profile.short_bio: Pan-Pot is a Berlin-based German techno duo consisting of Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix. They emerged in the mid-2000s on Mobilee Records and later founded the label Second State Audio, becoming mainstays of the international techno circuit. Their catalog includes the albums Pan-O-Rama and The Other, as well as the Watergate 02 mix.

profile.name: MD III
profile.short_bio: MD III is an alias of Chicago house producer Mike Dunn, best known for late-1980s releases on Trax Records. Classic cuts like The Pressure Cooker and Face The Nation exemplify his raw Chicago sound.
